relevant theory alongside a live, adjustable visualization — move the sliders, don't
just read the equations.

- [Yield Criteria](lectures/03-yield-criteria.qmd) — Von Mises vs Tresca on the π-plane
- [Elastic Constants](lectures/04-elastic-constants.qmd) — Poisson's ratio and Lamé parameters, with intuition
